body.text: Two smaller matters, which I held back so as not to put five questions in one letter.
The first is stock. A colony that must buy its own beef is a colony paying for it twice, and the beasts travel badly but they do travel.

The second is the cheapest thing I shall ever ask you for, and the one I press hardest. Books for the schoolrooms. Every town has children in a shack somewhere with somebody standing in front of them; what they lack is not a schoolroom but anything worth teaching in it.

A library raises one town a great deal and costs a great deal. This raises all of them a little and costs almost nothing, which means a colony too poor to build anything at all can still have some learning in it.

tone.text: Dr Meakin — on your two smaller matters I am {choice}.

options.text: aware there is always one more letter
